revised_prompts: Photorealistic 1920x1080 landscape frame from a fixed safety-inspection camera mounted about 1.5 meters above the floor, observing an indoor parking garage. Scene includes concrete pillars, parked vehicles, lane markings with industrial vinyl, and partial shadow from nearby structure, with clear subject detail. Left-oblique view at closer inspection distance, natural perspective, realistic scale, enough surrounding context to judge body support. Visible subject is a young adult woman with an athletic build wearing a pale sweater and black trousers, with blue and charcoal clothing tones, in a stable kneeling pose facing slightly away from the camera; neither the chest nor pelvis spread horizontally on the floor. Plausible unedited inspection-camera capture, subject clearly visible, clean floor markings that do not form symbols or labels. Ordinary photographic detail, restrained contrast, non-cinematic, non-advertising look. No text, caption, watermark, logo, warning label, overlay, bounding box, arrow, circle, or artificial annotation.
